about_the_game:
The Veiled Trial

Hidden deep within the Morwain house lies a truth that goes beyond the main story.

The Veiled Trial is an optional in-game challenge designed for players who enjoy uncovering secrets through careful observation, logic, and persistence.
It is not required to complete the game and does not affect the main ending.

All puzzles can be solved using information found naturally within the game world.
No brute force, no guessing, and no external guides are necessary.

Once the challenge becomes fully solvable, players will receive an in-game notification.

The first player to successfully complete The Veiled Trial will receive a €50 reward.
To ensure fairness, a full, unedited video recording of the solution process must be submitted for verification.

Further details are available in-game.

Veilborne Sacrament is a story-driven puzzle horror game that blends psychological tension with intricate environmental challenges.
As you enter the long-abandoned Morwain Mansion, you must investigate its decaying halls, decipher cryptic symbols, solve logical mechanisms, and unlock hidden spaces that reveal the truth about the Morwain family's disappearance.

Every puzzle you solve pushes the narrative forward, but it also awakens something lurking in the darkness. A distorted presence reacts to your progress, stalking you through the house as forgotten memories claw their way back into your mind.

This is not a walking simulator.
Every room, every clue, and every mechanism is deliberately crafted to challenge your observation, logic, and intuition. Piece together scattered documents, runic engravings, audio-based clues, and ritual components to survive the mansion’s haunting secrets.

Uncover the truth. Face what follows you.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Puzzle Horror – Solve integrated, story-driven puzzles that require logic, attention, and exploration.

  • Environmental Storytelling – Discover notes, runes, mechanisms, and hidden routes tied directly to the narrative.

  • Occult Rituals & Cryptic Codes – Combine symbols, audio cues, numerical riddles, and ritual components to progress.

  • Dynamic Stalking AI – A supernatural entity reacts to your actions and hunts you at key story moments.

  • Handcrafted Environments – Explore the mansion interior, underground chambers, ritual rooms, and forgotten pathways.

  • Psychological Narrative – Uncover your connection to the Morwains and the truth buried within the ritual.

  • Playable Demo – Experience the prologue that takes place three years before the events of the main game, introducing the mystery of the Morwain Mansion and the ritual that started it all.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains disturbing imagery, psychological horror themes, and mild depictions of blood and death.
Some scenes include lifeless bodies and unsettling environments.
No sexual or explicit content is present.
